input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "Write JavaScript I can paste into the browser console that reloads the current page every 2 minutes."
Message B: "Yes! This is going to be so much fun — write JavaScript I can paste into the browser console that reloads the current page every 2 minutes! I can't wait to see it refreshing!"

Which writer comes across as more **outgoing, energetic and assertive**?
(Sociable, talkative, enthusiastic and confident.)

Answer "A" or "B".
